title: Emails > Email Accounts > Setting Up Domain Email Accounts and MX Records

sections.heading: Connecting 3rd Party Email Providers
sections.content: You can connect your custom domain to third-party email providers such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or Zoho. To do this, point your custom domain's MX records to Google Workspace or your chosen provider in your DNS manager or cPanel.

sections.heading: Webmail vs External Hosting
sections.content: Brilliant Directories provides basic default webmail accounts for your admin domain, but professional agencies recommend routing all primary inbox traffic through Google Workspace for superior spam deliverability.

full_text:
Emails > Email Accounts > Setting Up Domain Email Accounts and MX Records
Connect Google Workspace by pointing MX records in DNS settings.
